title: Presence colours
why: Green, red and white all on screen at once, which is the only way to see that the third one is honest rather than a bug.
look: labMaster — the Connected to column, one node deliberately down

peers.name: bella
peers.expect: green — her node is up and holding both streams

peers.name: carlos
peers.expect: red — he has a row on both relays and his node is down. A relay SAYS he is absent, which is what makes this different from white.

peers.name: dina
peers.expect: white after the removal below — still in your contacts, named by no relay you are connected to

then.why: She stays in whoBook and leaves the roster, which is exactly the state white means. Without this step the scenario can only show two colours, and a three-colour rule with two colours on screen is untested by eye.
